notes_for_editor: Coordinates conflict: the record has 30.2304, -84.737 (from the Forest Lookouts map) and the Florida list has 30.19694, -84.72750, about 4 km apart. Not corrected here; a human should check which point is the tower before it is used. Only listing evidence was found; no build date, design, staffing, status, access or photo. The 1932 statewide count (source 4) is background only and does not name this tower. Budget: 2 web searches, about 5 page reads.
